newsitem.title: INDIA: Deutsche Bank cuts Indian prime rate to 17.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank cuts Indian prime rate to 17.25 pct.

text.p: Deutsche Bank said on Saturday it has decided to cut its Indian prime lending rate to 17.25 percent per annum from 18.25 percent with effect from November 1.
The bank has set a maximum spread of 4.0 percentage points over the prime lending rate, a bank official said.
"Our cost of funds have come down," the official told Reuters, explaining the basis for the reduction.

This week many banks have cut their prime rate after the central bank boosted banks' liquidity by reducing the cash reserve ratio requirement and lowered the interest ceiling on short-term deposits in its six monthly monetary policy on October 19.
